title: Template app guided-tour assets: annotated screenshots, README flow diagrams, and responsive mockups
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, developer-focused guided tour asset bundle for the Redwood template apps. Deliver annotated reference screenshots across desktop/tablet/mobile, a small set of in-README SVG flow diagrams that explain first-run configuration and token/cost visibility, and a 3-step interactive overlay concept for the web quickstart. Assets should be production-ready for the docs site and the template repo README and should account for localization and accessibility contrast requirements.
tasks: Audit current template app screenshots and README flows to identify gaps for first-run scenarios
Capture new high-resolution screenshots from template-app v0.9.2 with feature flags off and on
Produce annotated overlays for 6 primary screens: install, auth, first call, rate/usage view, console rollout, error handling
Design 3 SVG README diagrams: (1) minimal quickstart flow, (2) runtime routing overview, (3) cost/latency tradeoff illustration
Create responsive mockups for 1280px, 768px, and 360px widths; include margin-safe variants for docs site iframe
Generate localized screenshot sets for en-US, fr-FR, and de-DE (placeholder translations acceptable)
Export assets with annotated filenames and upload to Drive + add to template repo under docs/assets
Submit design review and collect engineering integration notes for embedding interactive overlay into starter app
Finalize README Markdown with inline SVGs and alt text; partner with Docs engineer for CI inclusion
acceptance_criteria: New annotated screenshots uploaded to Drive path: Drive:/Design/templates/onboarding/2025-10- (final) and linked in this ticket
README includes three inline SVG diagrams with accessible titles and descriptive alt text
Responsive mockups validated in the docs iframe and the starter app README on mobile width
Design review signed off by UX Lead (Marco Rivera) and PM (Jenna Li) in comments
Engineering acknowledges feasibility of interactive overlay and agrees on a lightweight integration plan
All exported PNG/SVG assets have filenames following repo conventions and include a short caption for the docs site
design_notes: Keep screenshots focused on 'developer outcomes' — show exact code snippet results and minimal chrome
Overlay CTA should not block code editors in the starter app; propose progressively revealed tips instead of modals
Favor SVG diagrams for README to allow color theming and responsive scaling in the docs site
Make contrast decisions to meet AA for normal text and AA Large for headings; provide alternate high-contrast variants
Localized screenshots can reuse English graphics where text is not critical; add translated captions where necessary
